definitions.explanation: Describes a person (especially a young woman) or quality that is morally pure, innocent, and untainted. Conveys a clean, fresh, and uncorrupted character.

examples.japanese: {清純|せいじゅん}なイメージの{女優|じょゆう}だ。
examples.english: She is an actress with a wholesome image.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{清純|せいじゅん}な{笑顔|えがお}が{魅力的|みりょくてき}だ。
{清純|せいじゅん}{派|は}で{売|う}り{出|だ}したアイドルが、{大人|おとな}っぽい{役|やく}に{挑戦|ちょうせん}して{話題|わだい}になった。
examples.english: An idol who debuted with a wholesome image made headlines by taking on a mature role.

notes:
Describes an image of moral purity and innocence, especially associated with young women in Japanese media and entertainment. Composed of {清|せい} (clean/pure) + {純|じゅん} (pure/genuine). Can function as a na-adjective: {清純|せいじゅん}な.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {清純|せいじゅん}な{少女|しょうじょ}: an innocent girl
- {清純|せいじゅん}なイメージ: a wholesome image
- {清純|せいじゅん}{派|は}: the wholesome/innocent type (in entertainment)
- {清純|せいじゅん}な{笑顔|えがお}: an innocent smile

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {純粋|じゅんすい}: pure — emphasizes being unmixed or genuine, broader usage
- {無垢|むく}: pure, innocent — stronger emphasis on being completely untainted
- {清楚|せいそ}: neat and modest — focuses on elegant simplicity in appearance and manner
- {素朴|そぼく}: simple, unpretentious — emphasizes naturalness and lack of sophistication

USAGE:
In Japanese entertainment, {清純|せいじゅん}{派|は} (the "innocent type") is a recognized category for idols and actresses who project a wholesome, pure image.
